entry.title: Capped hub
entry.summary: A hub with more children than its sidebar child cap, so the sidebar shows one entry for its pages.
entry.content:
This hub has five pages and a sidebar child cap of 3, set with sidebar_child_cap: 3 in this page’s frontmatter. Because five is more than three, the sidebar shows this hub’s overview link and one “5 pages” entry instead of the five pages.

Open any of the pages below. The “5 pages” entry is marked as the current page, and the previous and next links walk the pages in the order this list shows.
